selected_branches.branch: Pedestrian in or near a marked or unmarked crosswalk.

selected_branch: Pedestrian in or near a marked or unmarked crosswalk.
law_text: A driver of a motor vehicle shall: Exercise proper caution upon observing a pedestrian: (1) On or near a highway, street or road; (2) At or near a bus stop or bench, shelter or transit stop for passengers of public mass transportation or in the act of boarding a bus or other public transportation vehicle; or (3) In or near a school zone or a school crossing zone marked in accordance with NRS 484B.363 or a marked or unmarked crosswalk.

topic_inventory.exact-text: A driver of a motor vehicle shall: Exercise proper caution upon observing a pedestrian: (1) On or near a highway, street or road; (2) At or near a bus stop or bench, shelter or transit stop for passengers of public mass transportation or in the act of boarding a bus or other public transportation vehicle; or (3) In or near a school zone or a school crossing zone marked in accordance with NRS 484B.363 or a marked or unmarked crosswalk.

cases.purpose: Observe a pedestrian bodily in a source-marked crosswalk with original driver input and recorded response
Observe the same crossing geometry and response after removing the physical marking; retain intersection and curb continuity as an unmarked crosswalk

fixed_conditions: same original intersection roads, curbs, crossing extent and pedestrian route
same ego vehicle, driver identity, route, speed target and response policy
same separately recorded driver observation input source
same 20 Hz, duration and four-view camera contract
deliberate_differences: physical crosswalk marking present versus absent in the original map; crossing category read back from the Native scene

runtime_uncertainties: The authored crossing map must load in Native and its road, marking, curbs, pedestrian body, motion and camera pixels require local physical readback.
Original driver input is required separately from visual detectability; no numerical legal proper-caution threshold follows from crossing kind.

evidence_review.method: Read frozen law, original C233871 evidence and candidate catalog; no accepted recording covers marked/unmarked crosswalk variation in the fixed original cell.

gaps.requirement: Original crossing kind, pedestrian body, driver input and response history
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen accepted evidence inventory has no crosswalk variant.
